title: G8. Cardiovascular Disease Exercise Prescription
content:
### Cardiovascular Disease Exercise Prescription
**ID:** G8 **Created:** 2025-06-05

Cardiovascular disease exercise prescription involves designing safe and effective exercise programs for individuals with heart conditions, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and post-cardiac event recovery. This specialized approach emphasizes gradual progression, continuous monitoring, and multidisciplinary collaboration to improve cardiovascular health while minimizing risks.

**Core Components:**
- **Risk Stratification and Clearance:** Comprehensive assessment protocols to determine exercise safety and appropriate supervision levels, connecting to [[IX-6. Exercise Contraindications]] and [[Q4. Interpreting Biometric & Progress Data]]
- **Cardiac Rehabilitation Protocols:** Structured exercise progressions for post-event recovery and long-term cardiovascular health maintenance, linking to [[A39. Cardiovascular Adaptations to Training]] and [[A21. Principle of Progression]]
- **Heart Rate and Intensity Monitoring:** Precise exercise intensity prescription using heart rate zones, RPE, and other cardiovascular markers, relating to [[E13. Heart Rate Zone Training]] and [[A8. Cardiovascular Physiology Fundamentals]]
- **Aerobic Base Development:** Emphasis on low-to-moderate intensity cardiovascular training for improved cardiac function, connecting to [[E2. Steady-State Cardio (LISS - Low-Intensity Steady State)]] and [[E11. VO2 Max Training]]
- **Resistance Training Considerations:** Safe integration of strength training with modified protocols for cardiac populations, linking to [[B4. Strength Training Principles]] and [[A19. Principle of Overload]]
